caption: The drawing depicts two objects: a dagger and its sheath, set against a plain, pale beige background. The dagger is positioned to the right, displaying a straight, double-edged metallic blade with a defined central ridge and a gradually tapering point. Its hilt features a textured, brown grip, capped and accented with ornate, silvery metal fittings that display intricate scrollwork patterns. The crossguard is horizontal and forms a small, symmetrical wing on either side. To the left of the dagger is its sheath, which is predominantly dark brown with decorative silver metalwork at the top and bottom ends, both displaying similar ornate, scrolling designs as seen on the dagger’s hilt. From the sheath's top hangs a twisted golden-brown cord terminating in a tassel. The objects are rendered with detailed shading and a realistic style, emphasizing the textures of metal, fabric, and leather.
title: Dagger and Sheath
